d:
Canada’s oil-rich province of Alberta has voted to remain part of the country, with CBC projecting that around 76% backed staying in Canada and 23% supported starting the process towards a future separation referendum.
The result is a major boost for Prime Minister Mark Carney and supporters of Canadian unity.
But the vote also highlights the growing tensions between Alberta and Ottawa over energy policies, immigration and provincial autonomy. Will this decisive result put the separatist movement to rest?
